_readme: Search progress messages, English. {name} - value; {n:link|links} - number with the right word form; {size:size} - file size. Keep the same keys and {names} in en.json, zh.json and ru.json.
cache.negative: {site}: nothing was found here {days:day|days} ago, skipped
engine.quota: {engine} query: "{query}" — API daily limit reached, skipped
engine.offtopic: {engine} query: "{query}" — results do not match the query, skipped ({n:unrelated link|unrelated links})
site.slow_skip: {site} did not answer in time — skipped until restart
validate.ok: File check: format ✔ safe ✔ {pages:page|pages}, has text
validate.scan: File check: format ✔ safe ✔ {pages:page|pages}, scan without text
validate.not_pdf: File check: not a PDF, rejected
validate.encrypted: File check: the PDF is encrypted, rejected
validate.damaged: File check: the PDF is damaged or empty, rejected
verify.rejected: Content check: not a document for {part} — {score:point|points}
confirm.search: Confirmation: looking for an independent copy…
access.site_protected: {site}: the site is protected from programs, can be downloaded by hand
access.not_whitelisted: {site}: not in the program's allowed list, skipped
access.unknown: {site}: no answer, the cause is unclear
search.budget: Search stopped: the time limit of {seconds} s is used up
search.limit: Search stopped: the limit is used up — {queries:query|queries}, {downloads:download|downloads}
search.order_explore: Exploration: the rarely tried source {name} goes first
result.confirmed: Result: CONFIRMED — saved to the library ({queries:query|queries}, {seconds} s)
result.probable: Result: PROBABLE — saved, needs a look ({queries:query|queries}, {seconds} s)
result.rejected: Result: REJECTED — the documents found do not fit ({queries:query|queries}, {seconds} s)
ocr.unconfirmed: {provider} — confidence {conf}%, part number not confirmed by the reference
ocr.no_consent: {provider}: photo not sent — no consent to send
ocr.fallback: No confident result — using the text read by {provider}
